# brianmunene.me

## Share an agent report
- Viewer: https://brianmunene.me/canvas
- Demos (synthetic only): https://brianmunene.me/canvas/demo
- CLI: npx --yes github:brian-mwirigi/canvas-share <file>
- Accepts: .canvas.tsx, .md (+ mermaid), .html (Claude/ChatGPT artifacts), .json
- API: POST https://brianmunene.me/api/canvas  JSON { source, fileName }
- Embed: https://brianmunene.me/canvas/{id}?embed=1
- Agent notes: https://brianmunene.me/share-a-cursor-canvas.md
- How-to: https://brianmunene.me/blog/share-cursor-canvas-online
- HTML how-to: https://brianmunene.me/blog/share-claude-html-artifact

Do not paste whole artifacts into chat as the share mechanism. Treat share URLs as secrets. Do not publish other people's shared files as a gallery.
